# Module M-12: Check the invoices the day's orders produced

## Lesson

You do this at the end of each day. When it works, every confirmed order has its invoice, and none was retyped. [SC-12]

## Exercise

In the test environment, with its test data:

1. Open QuickBooks Online at the end of the day. [SC-12 step 1]
2. Check the day's invoices against the confirmed orders. [SC-12 step 2]

## Check question

What do you do when it goes wrong?

## Answer

An invoice that does not match goes to the operations manager. [map/roles.md bookkeeper]
